python3 << 'EOF'
# Values in millions of dollars
v1 = 6833543  # March 2009
v2 = 7551862  # September 2009

# Arc percent change calculation
difference = abs(v2 - v1)
average = (v1 + v2) / 2
arc_percent = (difference / average) * 100

print(f"March 2009: {v1:,} million")
print(f"September 2009: {v2:,} million")
print(f"Difference: {difference:,}")
print(f"Average: {average:,}")
print(f"Arc percent change: {arc_percent}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {arc_percent:.3f}%")
EOF
